unresolved.issue: Potential FP stacking: base Ballistakinesis half-on-miss versus Improved Ballistakinesis area-expansion. No text authorizes both from one FP; encode distinct choices until adjudicated.
Competing base/technique FP modes for Obscure, Stagger, and Force Shield. Do not silently combine, double-charge, or treat a single point as paying multiple enhancements.
Combustion ongoing fire uses initial UTF check TOTAL as fire attack bonus; confirm how fire attacks are scheduled/resolved by shared Core fire service without a duplicate fire subsystem.

Dark Transfer persistent condition cost applies to each use, including a failed healing check. Treatment alongside revival variant and Dark Preservation must respect explicit source costs and resource expenditure timing.
Legacy uses `equal or exceeds` for ability hit checks, and Ballistakinesis FP says targets you `fail to exceed`: treat equality as hit based on complete rule, not as half-damage miss.
Detonate printed damage type unspecified. Improved Detonate gives nearby targets slashing damage based on actual object damage; object hardness/DR and half rounding owned by shared DamageSystem.
Force Shield is a Legacy reprint of FUCG original, not a second learnable definition; repeated text read matches known origin, but verify formal published errata.
Official Legacy Era-specific errata was not independently authenticated in this pass. Printed pages 53–56 remain authority pending an official source.
Enlighten defense substitution scope: one chosen defense until next turn versus consumed one roll. Store source-specific distinction and do not invent repeated or unrestricted substitution.

Original Obscure “another creature adjacent to it” uses “target” for attacking enemy. Explicitly resolve adjacent-to-attacker for implementation; retain review if contradictory official clarification found.
